## Welcome!

My name is Yikai Lu. My academic background is in statistics,
with a focus on machine learning.

My interests include data science, biostatistics, and applications
of statistical methods to public health and medical research.

## About my work

My research experience includes analyzing cancer patient survival
and clinical and pathological data using Python. My projects have
also involved regression modeling and clinical trial analysis.

You can learn more about my experience on my [resume](resume.html).

## Outside of academics

I enjoy badminton, swimming, and sketching.
